title: People
subtitle: Who works here, who is in today, and what needs an answer from you.

items.title: 2 leave requests are waiting for you
items.body: Ada, 26 to 30 Oct, and Kunle, half a day on 2 Nov. The warehouse would be one short on 3 days.

items.body: A fire-safety certificate, two food handler medicals and a driver's licence. Expired ones cannot work some shifts.

items.title: October payroll is due on 28 October
items.body: 82 people, about ₦24.6m gross. Calculate by Friday so you can approve on Monday.
